title: The Sensuous Nurse
writer: Nello Rossati, Paolo Vidali, Claudia Florio
actors: Ursula Andress, Duilio Del Prete, Mario Pisu
plot: As an aging widower suffers from cardiac trouble, his greedy heirs hire a super-seductive nurse in the hopes of inducing a heart attack, but the plan backfires when she falls for him.
